trigger: A header, cookie or query parameter read by a unit's code (a handler's binding or a call on the request, in any class) whose name, case and dashes and underscores ignored, is user, account, member, role, permission, tenant, org or organization, optionally after x and followed by id, ids or s. One lead per unit and value.
judge: Whether anything strips or verifies the value on every path that reaches the unit.

trigger: A message send, HTTP call or mail send in code a method running in a read-write transaction (@Transactional on it or its class) reaches through the call graph, with no @TransactionalEventListener, afterCommit or outbox on the way. One lead per unit and sending method.
judge: Whether a consumer can act before the data commits, and what then breaks.

trigger: A call from one unit to another whose method and path match no endpoint of the unit it reaches (the receiver has endpoints and is not a gateway); or a frontend's call that matches an endpoint no route of the gateway reaches.
judge: Whether it fails, works by accident, or is dead code.

trigger: A POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE endpoint whose access check (method security or a custom check an aspect makes) names a permission ending in READ or VIEW, or that has none in a unit whose other endpoints have one.
judge: Whether the check lets callers do more than the permission says.

trigger: A type passed as a message payload or an HTTP client's request or response, declared in an in-set library that the units passing it bundle at different versions (version-skew).
judge: Whether the type differs between the versions in a way that breaks reading.

trigger: A unit or data store every deployment environment runs with replicas 1 or unset, that two or more units interact with; or a unit whose STOMP broker is the simple broker, with no relay.
A config value whose key names a secret, written as a literal (masked); a signing secret several units share (shared-secret); a Kubernetes Secret written as stringData.
A frontend's base URL whose host is localhost or a private address, in the environment file its default build uses, or in its code.
judge: Where the build works and where it does not.

trigger: A CORS policy (code, config or an ingress annotation) whose allowed origins are every origin, *, also as a placeholder's default.
judge: What a browser will and will not do.

trigger: spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto set to update, create or create-drop in the default view or a profile whose name does not say test, for a module with no Flyway or Liquibase migrations.
judge: What happens to data on a schema change.
